title: Smith Service
description: A named composition of repository projects. A service has no behavior of its own: it names a set of components and maps a closed vocabulary of service targets onto component targets. Execution order comes from project-level depends_on (service files never declare dependencies). Lives as an arbitrary-named *.yml directly inside the repo's reserved services/ project root.

version.description: File-format version. Always 1 for this schema.

name.description: Service name. Must be unique across the repository's services (enforced by smith at load, not expressible here).

components.description: The projects that make up this service. A component may map its own target names onto service targets (targets: {<component target>: <service target>}); without a mapping, a component implements a service target by name match. Components are validated against discovered projects by smith at load.

project.description: Project name, as declared in that project's smith.yml.

targets.description: Service-target mapping, direction component target -> service target: the component target named by the key implements the service target named by the value. Values are drawn from the closed service-target vocabulary.
